6d876069350700df2c509f2da8e5dc03bedbc61a.content: Acceleration is defined as the rate of change of velocity with respect to time: $\vec{a} = \frac{d\vec{v}}{dt}$. It is a vector quantity with SI unit $\text{m/s}^2$.
